note: The spine. Every provider Record Atlas can point at, with what it actually costs to look. `access` is the map's colour and must describe the ordinary visitor's experience, not the best case: FamilySearch is `account` because its images need a free login and some are locked to a Family History Centre. Every row carries `checked`; a row nobody has re-checked in a year should be treated as a claim, not a fact. `at` is where the paper is, or where the portal is run from, at CITY level — a street pin implies a precision that does not survive an institution moving building. A provider with no `at` has no single home: an aggregator, a commercial subscription, or a volunteer index that lives on a server.

access.catalogue: A catalogue entry only — the paper is not photographed

providers.name: Archives communales de Nice
providers.what: Nice Côte d'Azur — and the service tells you the honest thing straight out: what is online «ne représente qu'une partie des documents conservés», and in most cases you will have to come and read the originals. What the Bach search engine gives you is nearly two hundred finding aids covering ALL the ancient series plus much of the modern and private ones, indexed by place (107,061), person (35,274), administration, economy and printed matter. A partnership with the Bibliothèque du chevalier de Cessole extends it further. Treat it as a very good catalogue, not an image library.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /recherche-en-ligne/ reads «elles ne représentent qu'une partie des documents conservés. Dans la plupart des cas, la recherche nécessite donc la consultation sur place des documents originaux» and «notre moteur de recherche « Bach » met à votre disposition près de deux-cents instruments de recherche couvrant l'intégralité des séries anciennes». recherche.archives.nicecotedazur.org/archives/search opens with those index counts and no sign-in. The same page warns that Chrome users should open the portal in private browsing «afin d'éviter certains dysfonctionnements d'affichage ou de connexion».

providers.name: Archives municipales d'Aix-les-Bains
providers.what: Aix-les-Bains — and the service names the reason for its own earliest gap: A FIRE IN 1739 DESTROYED EVERYTHING BEFORE IT. What survives begins in the 18th century; the modern archives 1792–1983 run to 400 linear metres, split across three sites — the third floor of the municipal library and two annexes. The service publishes its inventories, a heritage library, a how-to-use guide, a page of other archive sources, and its own annual activity reports.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-10-09. /mes-loisirs/archives-municipales/presentation-des-archives reads «Le service des archives de la Ville d'Aix-les-Bains, créé en 1992, conserve des documents administratifs depuis le XVIIIe siècle. Un incendie en 1739 a détruit les archives antérieures. Les archives modernes (1792-1983) représentent 400 mètres linéaires. Les documents sont répartis entre 3 sites : le 3e étage de la bibliothèque municipale et 2 annexes.» The section also carries «Instruments de recherche dans les archives», «Bibliothèque patrimoniale des Archives», «Mode d'emploi» and «Autres sources d'archives». The atlas's url 404ed and has been corrected.

providers.name: Archives municipales d'Annecy
providers.what: Annecy. The service covers the HISTORIC COMMUNES that were merged into the commune nouvelle in 2017, over more than 700 years — urbanism, architecture, demography, politics, the economy, social and cultural life, transport, sport and public education. Open to anyone of any nationality on production of ID at the first visit each year, but only Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the documents cannot leave the reading room.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-10-09. providers.name: Archives municipales de Saint-Quentin
providers.what: Saint-Quentin — and this row is the reason to read the archive's own words rather than trust the departmental copy. The municipal service holds état civil and décennial tables 1792–1912 with ONE gap, the year 1799, the register lost in the First World War; plus the registers of all twelve Saint-Quentin parishes, the oldest 1582 for Saint-André, with gaps especially between 1720 and 1730, and alphabetical tables covering 1700–1792. The greffe duplicates ARE online free at the Archives de l'Aisne — but the service states plainly that the departmental set has gaps ITS OWN registers do not. If the online copy fails you, the paper at the mairie may not.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /334-genealogie.htm reads «de 1792 à 1912. Seule lacune, l'année 1799, le registre ayant disparu lors de la première guerre mondiale … les registres des 12 paroisses … Le plus ancien date de 1582, pour la paroisse Saint André … plusieurs lacunes … en particulier entre 1720 et 1730 … tables alphabétiques de 1700 à 1792», and then «Les registres du greffe … sont en ligne sur le site www.archives.aisne.fr. Outre certaines lacunes qui n'existent pas dans notre service, en venant notre salle de lecture vous pourrez bénéficier de l'aide du personnel». Généalogie-Aisne holds a monthly help session there during term. Access recorded onsite because the municipal registers themselves are not published online; copies are sent on request.

Four genealogical series: état civil, the population censuses, THE MUNICIPAL CEMETERIES OF BORDEAUX AND CAUDÉRAN 1814–1974, and the registration of foreign nationals — the last two are rare online and both matter for anyone whose family arrived rather than stayed.

The host sits behind a proof-of-work interstitial («Making sure you're not a bot!», «Difficulty: 2»); it cleared on its own in about ten seconds. curl gets HTTP 403.

providers.name: Centre d’archives patrimoniales. Fabrique des savoirs
providers.what: The Centre d'archives patrimoniales at the Fabrique des savoirs, for Rouen Normandie Métropole. Reading room Thursdays and Fridays, 2 to 6; free, but EXCLUSIVELY on site, after registration with ID, and documents must be reserved at least 24 hours ahead. Genealogical enquiries by post have to name precisely dated acts AND ENCLOSE A STAMPED ENVELOPE for the reply.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-10-09 from the service's own page; no online collections offered there. lafabriquedessavoirs.fr/fr/centre-d-archives-patrimoniales reads «La consultation est libre et gratuite et se fait exclusivement sur place après inscription sur présentation d'une pièce d'identité lors de la première visite», «Les documents sont à réserver au moins 24h à l'avance», and «Recherches à caractère généalogique : la demande doit porter sur des actes précisément datés et être accompagnée d'une enveloppe timbrée pour la réponse».

providers.name: Archives de l'agglomération Évreux Portes de Normandie
providers.what: The municipal archive of agglomération Évreux Portes de Normandie — a French commune's own papers: its copy of the état civil, council deliberations, the cadastre. NOT the département's register series, which is held by its archives départementales. Harvested from Wikidata and not yet opened.
providers.triageNote: Unreachable 2026-10-09. archives.epn-agglo.fr (81.255.106.139) times out, and so does www.epn-agglo.fr on a different address (193.70.41.244) — two hosts, both silent, so this is not one broken subdomain. Row stays unsurveyed.

providers.name: Archives de Nantes
providers.what: Nantes Métropole. Eighteen digitised collections, among them the burial registers and the registers of funerary inscriptions with a nominative search — a series most archives never digitise. Collaborative indexing is open to the public. The reading room is shut in 2026 while the collections move; the online collections are not.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09. archives.nantes.fr/archives-numerisees/ reads «Les Archives de Nantes mettent en ligne leurs fonds numérisés … 18 résultats trouvés», listing «Registres d'état civil · Registres paroissiaux · Registres d'inhumations · Registres d'inhumations et d'inscriptions funéraires (Recherche nominative) · Recensements …». «Indexation collaborative» is in the same menu. No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives de Strasbourg
providers.what: Strasbourg, for the city and the Eurométropole — and the site is published in French AND German, which for Alsace is not decoration. The état civil search lets you pick the act type: birth, marriage and death registers, and the décennial tables for each.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /archive/recherche/etatcivil/n:238 opens as «Je cherche une personne > État civil» with 30 form controls and act types «registre des naissances · registre des mariages · registre des décès · table décennale des naissances · table décennale …». The page header carries «Français Deutsch». The host sits behind a proof-of-work interstitial («Making sure you're not a bot!», «Difficulty: 2»); it cleared on its own in about ten seconds. curl gets HTTP 403.

providers.name: Acta Croatica
providers.what: Croatian historical documents indexed by the people named in them, plus a page per surname giving its spelling variants, the towns it is thickest in, and where its bearers emigrated. The closest thing anywhere to what this atlas does, done for names instead of places. Its figures are derived and carry no stated licence, so this is a link, not a source of rows.

providers.name: Acta Publica
providers.what: Moravian and Silesian parish registers, free. The Czech regional archives each publish their own; this is the Brno one.

providers.name: Digitální badatelna — Zemský archiv v Opavě
providers.what: The Silesian Land Archive's own digital reading room, and the other half of Czech Moravia-Silesia that provider `actapublica` does not cover — its row says the regional archives each publish their own and this is the Opava one. ELEVEN ARCHIVES IN ONE SEARCH: the land archive itself, its Olomouc branch, and the district archives (SOkA) of Bruntál-Krnov, Frýdek-Místek, Jeseník, Karviná, Nový Jičín, Olomouc, Opava, Prostějov, Přerov and Šumperk. 2,511,688 records and 20,689,527 digital attachments on the day this was checked, and it is actively grown — 574 records were added that day. FAR MORE THAN REGISTERS. `Matriky` are the parish registers (birth, marriage and death, Catholic and Protestant), but the same search also reaches `Sčítání` census returns down to the individual household sheet, `Pozemkové knihy` land books, `Kroniky` chronicles, `Kartotéky` card indexes including police registration cards for a town, `Třídní výkazy` school class registers, maps, photographs and charters. For a family that stayed put, the census sheet and the police card say what a register cannot. A SEARCH CAN BE HANDED TO SOMEBODY: /da/searchlink/<hash> is a stable address for a result set — checked on a Catholic birth-register search for Olomouc Sv. Michal 1760-1851, which returned 1,412 images with no account and no challenge. ONE CAVEAT, RECORDED BECAUSE IT WAS MET. The host sits behind a Radware bot manager, and an automated request is redirected to /da/human/challenge. A person in a browser passes it without noticing; a script does not, and this atlas does not work around bot gates. So the row is `free` for a reader, and anything automated should expect the challenge rather than treat it as the site being down.
providers.triageNote: Opened and read on 2026-10-05. `free` was checked rather than assumed: no login appears anywhere on the page and a deep-linked search returned its images without one. The bot gate was met on the first automated attempt and is written into `what` rather than worked around.

providers.name: eBadatelna — Státní oblastní archiv v Praze
providers.what: The State Regional Archives in Prague, for CENTRAL BOHEMIA — the region around Prague, not the city itself, which keeps its own archive (see provider `ahmp-praga-publica`). Its own description: remote access to digitised registers and other archival records, and in the Register Records section «a complete digitized collection of registers of the Central Bohemia region». The site offers Login and Register, so an account exists; whether images open without one has not been checked here, which is why this row is `unsurveyed` and not `free`.
providers.triageNote: Opened on 2026-10-05 and confirmed live and serving its own catalogue. `unsurveyed` is the honest level rather than a guess: the identity, the ground it covers and the record types are read off the site, but nobody has opened an image through it, so whether that needs an account is not yet established. Whoever surveys it should set `access` from the legend and date `checked`.

providers.name: DigiArchiv — Státní oblastní archiv v Třeboni
providers.what: The State Regional Archives in Třeboň, for SOUTH BOHEMIA. Running since 2007 and badged «19 years of digitisation» at the time of checking, with a folder tree, a search and a three-language interface (Czech, German, English) — German matters here, because the records of this ground are largely German-language before 1945. The catalogue renders through JavaScript that did not fill in for an automated reader, so the holdings could be seen to exist but not counted.

providers.name: Digitální badatelna — Státní oblastní archiv v Litoměřicích
providers.what: The State Regional Archives in Litoměřice, for NORTH BOHEMIA — the ground that was the Sudetenland, so a family expelled in 1945-46 has its registers here rather than anywhere they later lived. Same software as Opava's digital reading room and the same breadth beyond registers: `Matriky` parish registers, `Městské knihy` town books, `Kroniky` chronicles, `Listiny` charters, maps, photographs and finding aids, all in one search. Reached via vademecum.soalitomerice.cz, which redirects here — the redirect target is the address to keep.

Whoever surveys it should set `access` from the legend and date `checked`.

providers.name: Archivní katalog — Archiv hlavního města Prahy
providers.what: PRAGUE THE CITY KEEPS ITS OWN ARCHIVE, separate from the State Regional Archives in Prague that holds the region around it — a distinction that sends people to the wrong catalogue. Holds the Collection of Registry Books and, unusually and valuably, the PRAGUE POPULATION REGISTER 1830-1910 (1920): a residence register naming people house by house, which answers «when did they arrive in the city and from where» in a way no parish book does. Also council minutes 1784-1945, photographs, parchment and paper charters. Interface in Czech, English and German.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Alpes-Maritimes
providers.what: The archives départementales for Alpes-Maritimes — in France, where a département's parish registers and civil registers are deposited. Harvested from Wikidata and not yet opened: what is online, and at what price, is unchecked.

Please consult with your administrator. Your support ID is: 16102489503195326698». curl receives HTTP 200, which is the block page itself and not the site. providers.name: Archives du département du Rhône et de la métropole de Lyon
providers.what: Lyon, for both the département and the métropole. «Archives consultables en ligne» covers état civil, recensements, cadastre, notaires, the insinuations du Beaujolais, hypothèques, military recruitment, enfance assistée and the Montluc prison records.

providers.name: Archives d'Alsace — Bas-Rhin
providers.what: Strasbourg. Registers free online, and written in whichever language the ground belonged to that decade — French to 1871, German to 1918, French again, German again from 1940.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Bouches-du-Rhône
providers.what: Marseille. Parish and civil registers for the communes of the département, sixteenth century to 1925, with recensements 1836–1968 and — unusually deep — alphabetical répertoires of the notaries' acts running from 1361 to 1938.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /n/archives-numerisees/n:1: «Registres paroissiaux et état civil — Communes des Bouches-du-Rhône (XVIe s.-1925)» and «Répertoires alphabétiques des actes des notaires des Bouches-du-Rhône (1361-1938)». No account asked for. The site itself warns of ongoing incidents; it answered throughout this survey.

providers.name: Archives départementales du Calvados
providers.what: Caen. The 4E sub-series holds the parish and civil registers from the bailliage and tribunal greffes. Its own description records that these were microfilmed by the Mormons in the 1960s and that it is that microfilm set which was digitised — «complété pour la période postérieure à 1860» — so what is online here and what FamilySearch holds come from one filming, and the post-1860 part is the département's own work.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. The état des fonds, the 4E description and the geographic search form all open without an account: «Vous pouvez également accéder à la carte des communes du Calvados, pour y retrouver les archives déposées et l'état civil de chaque commune.» A «Mon espace personnel» login exists and is never required to reach any of it, so `free` rather than `account` — the same bar ad-tarn was promoted on. NOT VERIFIED: an individual register image was not opened; the catalogue tree is JavaScript and the commune list is behind a select widget, so this says the search is open, not that a page of a register was displayed.

providers.name: Archives départementales du Cantal
providers.what: Aurillac. État civil from the origins to 1932, deaths to the 1950s. Recensements to 1936, tables des successions from the Revolution to 1956 (from 1757 at Allanche), contrats de mariage from the mid-eighteenth century to 1865 (1731 at Murat), matricules for the classes 1885–1921 with the earlier ones promised.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /rechercher/genealogie: «État civil — Etat civil des origines jusqu'en 1932 (années 1950 pour les décès).» No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Charente
providers.what: Angoulême, on the «La Source» portal. Tables décennales and état civil to 1942, some registers to 1952 and some acts to 1945. TWO TIERS, and the line is the hundred-year rule: tables décennales carry no personal data and are open to everyone, while an ACT may only be published online once a century has passed — for the recent ones you sign in with FranceConnect, the French state identity service. Everything a genealogist is usually after is the open half.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. «Les tables décennales ne comportant pas de données à caractère personnel, elles sont visibles par tous, sans restriction ! Les actes d'état civil ne sont diffusables sur Internet qu'une fois un délai de 100 ans passé. Une solution pour pouvoir les consulter depuis chez vous : vous connecter à La Source via France Connect.» Classed `free` rather than `account` because the account is required only for the most recent century, which is closed on paper too; `mixed` would be wrong, since nothing here is paid. NOTE: the host answers a browser after a «Making sure you're not a bot!» interstitial — another gate rather than a grave, as with ad-tarn.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Charente-Maritime
providers.what: La Rochelle and Jonzac. «Plus de 5,5 millions d'images consultables depuis chez vous» — état civil and parish registers, and separately the PROTESTANT registers of baptisms, marriages and burials for 1561–1793 and 1806–1831, which is the Huguenot record this coast is the place to look for.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /archives-en-ligne: «Consulter les documents numérisés — Plus de 5,5 millions d'images consultables depuis chez vous !», listing État Civil, «Registres protestants (1561-1793, 1806-1831)», recensements 1851–1946 and matricules. No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales du Cher
providers.what: Bourges. The greffe collection of parish registers before 1792 is digitised IN FULL; the communal collection — often the older of the two — only for communes that deposited their archives here, so a gap online is a question about where the register is kept, not whether it exists. Diffusion follows 100 years for births and 75 for marriages; the most recent acts online are 1947.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /archives-numerisees/registres-paroissiaux-et-etat-civil: «un délai de 100 ans pour les actes de naissance et de 75 ans pour les actes de mariage. Les actes les plus récents … sont datés de 1947» and «ont numérisé l'intégralité de la collection du greffe des registres paroissiaux (avant 1792). La collection communale, souvent plus ancienne, n'a été numérisée que pour les communes ayant procédé à un dépôt». No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Collectivité territoriale de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon
providers.what: L'Arche, the combined museum and archive at Saint-Pierre, which holds the records of Saint-Pierre, Miquelon-Langlade and the Île-aux-Chiens. The archives building burned in 1992 and the service says so plainly: some documents no longer exist and others are damaged. What survives is published as downloadable PDFs under «Archives en ligne» — censuses from the 18th to the early 20th century, population movements, and a roll of sailors lost and deceased.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /fr/54-recensements.html is headed «Archives en ligne : population» and links the 1882 and 1887 census PDFs directly. The same page reads «Suite à l'incendie du bâtiment des archives en 1992 certains documents n'existent plus et d'autres ont été endommagées». /fr/76-mouvements-de-population.html and /fr/83-marins-disparus-et-decedes.html sit beside it.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Corrèze

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Haute-Loire
providers.what: Le Puy-en-Velay. État civil, tables décennales and cantonales, recensements, matricules, the tables of the Contrôle des actes and hypothèques, and the notaries. UNUSUALLY, IT STATES ITS REUSE TERMS: reuse of the public information it holds is «libre et gratuite, quelle que soit la finalité poursuivie», with no authorisation needed — most French départementales leave that unsaid.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /archives-en-ligne/familles-et-individus-en-haute-loire lists «État civil, tables décennales, recensements de population, tables et registres matricules», and the same page states: «La réutilisation des informations publiques conservées par les Archives de la Haute-Loire est libre et gratuite, quelle que soit la finalité poursuivie. En pratique, cela signifie qu'aucune autorisation du service d'archives n'est nécessaire». No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Haute-Marne
providers.what: Chaumont. BOTH collections are online and named as such: the collection départementale (1 E, 1566–1942, arranged by commune, the duplicate copies kept since the Ancien Régime) and the collection communale (E dépôt). The last transfer from the Tribunal de Chaumont, in 2017, brought the registers up to 1942.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. «Registres paroissiaux et d'état civil, collection départementale (1 E) … Dates extrêmes : 1566 – 1942. Classé par commune.» and a second entry for the collection communale (E dépôt). No account asked for; cookie banner left unanswered.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Haute-Saône
providers.what: Vesoul. Parish and civil registers in sous-série 3 E, tables décennales separately, both searchable online by commune.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. The site carries «Registres paroissiaux et de l'état civil, sous-série 3 E» and «Tables décennales de l'état civil» as their own sections, with a working état civil search at /archive/recherche/etatcivil2. No account asked for. Another «Making sure you're not a bot!» host.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Haute-Savoie
providers.what: Annecy, and its holdings are a different state's. Savoy was Sardinian until 1860, so beside the état civil and recensements sit the MAPPES SARDES, the TABELLION D'ANCIEN RÉGIME (1660–1798) and the TABELLION DE LA RESTAURATION SARDE (1814–1861), with the comptes de châtellenie behind them. A researcher who expects only French series here will miss most of the paper.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /archive/recherche/etatcivil searches by commune, document type (registres, tables décennales) and act, with no account; the «Consulter les archives numérisées» list names the Mappes Sardes and both Tabellion series. Another «Making sure you're not a bot!» host. The site itself warns of slow page and image loading.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Haute-Vienne
providers.what: Limoges. État civil digitised and, in the archive's own words, «librement accessibles en ligne». For anything still reading-room only it will send a copy by post on request — name, type of act, exact date and commune, through the reproduction form — which is the practical route for a researcher who cannot travel to Limoges.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /rechercher/archives-en-ligne: «Dès lors que les actes d'état civil sont numérisés et librement accessibles en ligne, les Archives départementales ne se substituent pas au chercheur… Si les actes souhaités sont consultables uniquement en salle de lecture… nous pouvons vous adresser une copie du ou des acte(s) souhaités sur simple demande.» No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Hautes-Alpes
providers.what: Gap. État civil, recensements, cadastre, matricules, notaires, hypothèques, délibérations communales, prison registers and the 14-18 collections, all under «Archives numérisées». It also publishes PALAEOGRAPHY TUTORIALS online, which is the barrier most readers actually hit once the register is in front of them, and a stated policy on reuse of public information.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. The navigation lists «Archives numérisées — Recensements de la population, État civil, Iconothèque, Cadastre, Matricules, Notaires, Hypothèques…» with a search at /archive/recherche/etatcivil, no account. Another «Making sure you're not a bot!» host.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Hautes-Pyrénées
providers.what: Tarbes. Its thematic index is arranged by what a life does — «Naître, vivre et mourir» holds the parish registers, état civil, tables décennales, recensements, matricules, Enregistrement, Hypothèques and the REGISTRES DE PASSEPORTS, with the CARTES D'IDENTITÉ DE FRANÇAIS (1943-1944) beside them. Also the procès-verbaux de visite pastorale, which is parish history from the bishop's side.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — it was one of the twelve carrying «the homepage renders client-side». It does not: 154 links on the home page, and /archives/acces-thematique lists the series above. No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Hauts-de-Seine
providers.what: Nanterre. Parish registers and état civil searched separately, each by parish or commune and year, with enregistrement, recensements, electoral and military lists, notaries, hypothèques, cadastre — and REGISTRES MATRICULES SCOLAIRES, school enrolment registers, which place a child by name and year when no other series will. Like Yvelines and Val-de-Marne this département was cut out of the old Seine-et-Oise and Seine in 1968.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 118 links; /archive/recherche/registresparoissiaux and /archive/recherche/etatcivil are both open searches taking parish or commune and a year range, with no account. Cookie banner left unanswered.

providers.name: Archives départementales d'Indre-et-Loire
providers.what: Tours. Its digitised holdings are indexed by what you are looking for rather than by series — «Des personnes et des familles», «Un militaire, un conscrit», «Un bien immobilier ou mobilier», «Dans les archives avant 1790» — with the notarial minutes and répertoires, the press and annuaires, the 2019 cahiers citoyens and archaeological excavation reports.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 90 links; /page/archives-numerisees lists the sections above. No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales du Jura
providers.what: Montmorot. Parish and civil registers, dénombrements, contrôle des actes, matricules, arpentements communaux and cadastre — and two things most départementales do not have online: the DISPENSES DE MARIAGE 1742–1791, which record why a couple needed permission and therefore how they were related, and the manuscripts of the abbey of Saint-Claude, ninth to fifteenth century.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 93 links; /page/acces-aux-documents-numerises lists «Registres paroissiaux et d'état-civil», «Dispenses de mariage (1742-1791)» and «Manuscrits de l'abbaye de Saint-Claude (Jura), IXe - XVe s.». No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Ain
providers.what: Bourg-en-Bresse. État civil, cadastre, recensements, military and notarial series, tables de successions, hypothèques — «13 siècles d'histoire, 7 siècles d'archives en ligne» — with the comptes des châtellenies, the archives of the diocese of Belley-Ars, the 1906 inventory of church property, the cahiers de doléances and the letters of poilus.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 85 links; /archive/recherche/etatcivil is an open search, no account. Answers a browser only after a «Making sure you're not a bot!» interstitial.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Aisne
providers.what: Laon. État civil searched by commune, act type and date, with the act types listed separately — baptême, naissance, mariage, publication de mariage, sépulture, décès, table décennale AND REGISTRE PROTESTANT. A date converter for the calendrier républicain sits in the form.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 123 links; /archive/recherche/etatcivil offers the act types above including «Registre protestant», and a républicain date converter. No account. Another anti-bot host.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Allier
providers.what: Moulins. «Archives numérisées» opens on «Généalogie, histoire des familles», with the tables des successions et absences, the état sommaire and sommier des fiefs of the généralité de Moulins, and — unusually for a départementale — the Cahiers citoyens and the submissions to the Grand Débat national of 2019, which is a civic archive of the living rather than of the dead.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER, and it is the worked example for the thirteen rows still carrying the note this one used to carry. That note said «the homepage renders client-side» on the strength of a scripted fetch returning nothing. A browser gets the home page at once, 62 links, «Archives numérisées» in the navigation, and /rechercher/archives-numerisees lists «Généalogie, histoire des familles». No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Ardèche
providers.what: Privas, and the split here is unusual and worth knowing. The digitised registers are online under «Familles et individus». THE NAME INDEX IS NOT: «Expo Actes», the nominative database built by the Société des amateurs de généalogie de l'Ardèche over parish, protestant, revolutionary and notarial acts, «n'est accessible qu'en salle de lecture des Archives départementales ou si vous êtes adhérents à la SAGA». The opposite of Loiret and Vendée, where the volunteer index is the free part.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 80 links; /n/chercher-en-ligne lists «Archives numérisées… Familles et individus». The Expo Actes restriction is quoted above from /n/archives-numerisees-et-numeriques. Images free, index restricted, so `free` with the caveat in `what` rather than `mixed`, which would wrongly imply payment.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Ariège
providers.what: Foix. «Archives en ligne» carries état civil, registres matricules militaires and recensements de la population, each with its own section.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser, SUPERSEDING the 5 October scripted check that recorded an http refusal. The host sits behind an «Anti-DDoS Flood Protection and Firewall» page which took about FIFTEEN SECONDS to clear — longer than the five-second wait that sufficed for the other eight anti-bot hosts in this survey, and long enough that an impatient check would call it dead. Behind it: /rechercher-et-consulter/archives-en-ligne/etat-civil/, open, no account.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Aube
providers.what: Troyes. «Faire l'histoire de ma famille» gathers état civil, registres matricules and registres d'écrou, with the cadastre napoléonien, hypothèques and tables de successions under the house rather than the family. The recensements now run to 1975 — AND THE ARCHIVE SAYS WHAT IS MISSING FROM THEM: «les listes de nombreuses communes sont absentes» from the 1946, 1954, 1962, 1968 and 1975 holdings, so a commune not found there is not a commune uncounted.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — another of the twelve. 95 links on the home page, /recherches/documents-numerises opens on «Faire l'histoire de ma famille». No account asked for. Its viewer allows saving images and reporting errors.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Aude
providers.what: Carcassonne. Parish and civil registers from the middle of the sixteenth century — the Montolieu parish register of 1547 — to 1922, with the communal tables décennales, searched by commune or parish. IT DEFUSES A REVOLUTIONARY TRAP: the marriages of the years VII and VIII were registered at the canton seat, and the images are cross-linked to every commune in the canton, so they can be found from the commune you expected rather than the one that recorded them. Name changes are flagged with cross-references.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /letat-civil: «les registres paroissiaux et les registres d'état civil de l'Aude du milieu du XVIe siècle (registre paroissial de Montolieu daté de 1547) à 1922… les mariages des ans VII et VIII enregistrés au chef-lieu de canton ont été rattachés à toutes les communes du canton». No account. Supersedes the 5 October scripted check.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Aveyron
providers.what: Rodez. État civil, recensements, matricules, notaires, cadastre napoléonien and tables de successions, with access by commune — and a DICTIONNAIRE DES LIEUX HABITÉS DU DÉPARTEMENT, which is the tool for the hamlet that appears in a register under a name no modern map carries.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /n/archives-numerisees/n:119 lists ETAT CIVIL, RECENSEMENTS, MATRICULES, NOTAIRES, CADASTRE NAPOLÉONIEN, TABLES DE SUCCESSIONS, DICTIONNAIRE DES LIEUX HABITÉS and PRESSE ANCIENNE. No account.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Essonne
providers.what: Chamarande, and the FOURTH 1968 successor to the old Seine-et-Oise surveyed here after Yvelines, Val-de-Marne and Hauts-de-Seine. État civil and parish registers, recensements, notaires, hypothèques, successions, plans cadastraux and the plans d'intendance.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. /page/par-thematique lists «Etat civil et registres paroissiaux, Recensement de population, Notaires, Hypothèques, Successions, Plans cadastraux, Plans d'intendance». A login exists for a personal space and is not required to reach any of it.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Eure
providers.what: Évreux. État civil and the other digitised series online, with separate guides written for the amateur and the professional genealogist.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 127 links; /page/etat-civil-et-autres-documents-en-ligne, /page/genealogiste-amateur and /page/genealogiste-professionnel are all reachable with no account.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Hérault
providers.what: Montpellier, inside the Pierresvives building it shares with the departmental média­thèque, whose catalogue is searched alongside the archives.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 94 links; /n/archives-en-ligne/n:1 and /n/archives-et-inventaires-en-ligne/n:24 are reachable with no account. Another «Making sure you're not a bot!» host — the tenth in this survey. NOT ESTABLISHED: the exact register coverage; the site's content loads into a shell that a fetch returns only the navigation of, and this survey went no deeper than confirming the online archives are open.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Indre
providers.what: Châteauroux. «Fonds numérisés» splits into «Recherches généalogiques» — état civil, recensements, registres matricules militaires, contrôle des actes, enregistrement — and «Recherches foncières», with a separate entry per commune.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — another of the twelve. 90 links on the home page and /fonds-numerises/recherches-genealogiques lists the series above. No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Isère
providers.what: Grenoble, with the images on a separate portal at archivesenligne1.archives-isere.fr. Parish and civil registers and the tables décennales have their own instrument de recherche. The site is published in French, English, German, Italian and Spanish, which is rare here.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. The host answers through a «/shield» interstitial first; 154 links behind it, and /page/registres-paroissiaux-et-detat-civil plus the portal link are reachable with no account.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Oise
providers.what: The archives départementales for Oise — in France, where a département's parish registers and civil registers are deposited. Harvested from Wikidata and not yet opened: what is online, and at what price, is unchecked.
providers.triageNote: Declined 2026-10-09, twice. archives.oise.fr sits behind Cloudflare and the interstitial never resolves: «Performing security verification … This page is displayed while the website verifies you are not a bot. Ray ID: a47a11fddf79d70c», still showing after sixteen seconds in a real browser; curl gets HTTP 403. Row stays unsurveyed.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Orne
providers.what: Alençon. État civil has its own section under «Consulter nos archives en ligne», alongside the état des fonds and the online inventories.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 70 links; /etat-civil and /consulter-nos-archives-en-ligne both reachable with no account.

providers.name: Archives départementales de l'Yonne
providers.what: Auxerre. État civil searchable directly, with the state and departmental administrative series and the patrimoine civil alongside.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser. 117 links; /archive/recherche/etatcivil is an open search with no account. Another anti-bot host — the twelfth.

providers.name: Archives de la Collectivité européenne d'Alsace
providers.what: The Collectivité européenne d'Alsace, holding the Bas-Rhin and Haut-Rhin services together. Family and genealogy guidance of its own, and separately the archives of the PARISHES AND ECCLESIASTICAL INSTITUTIONS — which matter more here than almost anywhere in France, because Alsace kept the Concordat and its religious registers did not stop where the rest of the country's did.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER, and it CORRECTS AN EARLIER VERDICT. This row was marked `unreachable` from the 5 October scripted sweep, and the worklist recorded that it «needs a corrected URL first». The URL is fine: https://archives.alsace.eu/ answers a browser immediately, 119 links, with /votre-recherche/aide-a-la-recherche/famille-et-genealogie/ and /vos-archives/paroisses-et-institutions-ecclesiastiques/ both open and no account asked for. Nothing needed correcting except the conclusion.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Landes
providers.what: Mont-de-Marsan. «Archives numérisées» is split the way a reader actually arrives — «rechercher une personne» and «recherches sur une commune» — rather than by archival series.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser, superseding the 5 October scripted check that recorded an http refusal. 135 links; /faire-une-recherche/archives-numerisees and its person and commune entry points are open with no account.

providers.name: Archives départementales de Loir-et-Cher
providers.what: Blois. «Archives en ligne» with its own guidance for the genealogist and a separate route for finding a single act of état civil.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. 163 links; /n/archives-en-ligne/n:142, /n/genealogiste/n:164 and /n/un-acte-d-etat-civil/n:263 all reachable. Another anti-bot host.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Loire
providers.what: Saint-Étienne. «Archives numérisées en ligne» alongside the online inventories.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. 120 links; /n/archives-numerisees-en-ligne/n:90 reachable. Another anti-bot host.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Loire-Atlantique
providers.what: Nantes. Archives numérisées with a recently replaced viewer; the site is published in French and English.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. 144 links; the archives numérisées sections are reachable. Cookie banner left unanswered.

providers.name: Archives départementales du Loiret
providers.what: Orléans. Parish and civil registers to 1902 — and over them a VOLUNTEER NAME INDEX: 435,911 collaborative annotations and 172,051 bookmarks so far, with their own search. That is the difference between a register you can browse by commune and date and one you can search by the name you are actually looking for, and few départementales have it.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — one of the twelve wrongly noted as client-side. 228 links on the home page; /faire-vos-recherches/archives-numerisees/etat-civil carries «Registres paroissiaux et état civil du Loiret jusqu'en 1902» and the annotation counts above, with «Recherche dans les annotations de l'état civil» as a separate search. No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales du Lot
providers.what: Cahors. «Archives numérisées en accès direct»: parish and civil registers from the seventeenth century to 1922 (BMS and NMD), recensements 1836–1946, cadastre, enregistrement, hypothèques, military registers and two local papers. LIKE HAUTE-LOIRE IT STATES ITS REUSE TERMS: these being public and freely communicable records, «la réutilisation de ces images est également libre et gratuite».
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — one of the twelve. 214 links on the home page; /recherche-en-ligne/archives-numerisees names the series and the reuse terms. No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de Lot-et-Garonne
providers.what: Agen, with the images on a separate platform at lotetgaronne.archives.prismia.fr. État civil has its own «premiers pas» guide for readers who have not used a register before.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. 204 links; /rechercher/conseils-de-recherche/premiers-pas-dans-letat-civil and the prismia État civil search both reachable.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Lozère
providers.what: Mende. État civil searchable directly, with the état général des fonds and a route in from the digitised archives.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. 145 links; /archive/recherche/etatcivil/n:88 is an open search. Another anti-bot host.

providers.name: Archives départementales de Maine-et-Loire
providers.what: Angers. Archives numérisées under «Rechercher et consulter».
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. 100 links; /recherche-et-consulter/archives-numerisees reachable.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Manche
providers.what: Saint-Lô, and it answers the absence question better than any archive surveyed so far. Every surviving collection for the Manche up to 1892 is microfilmed and online; later registers are originals in the reading room. AND IF THE ACT IS NOT THERE, IT SAYS WHY: the register was lost before it reached the archive, or DESTROYED IN THE BOMBARDMENTS OF 1944. The inventory of sous-série 2 E, published in 1943 — before the bombing — lists which parish registers were already gone, so a researcher can tell a wartime loss from an older one.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — one of the twelve wrongly noted as client-side; 104 links on the home page. «Toutes les collections existantes pour la Manche jusqu'en 1892 ont été microfilmées et mises en ligne… Si vous ne trouvez pas l'acte que vous recherchez, c'est sans doute que le registre a été perdu avant son arrivée aux archives ou détruit lors des bombardements en 1944. On trouvera dans l'inventaire de la sous-série 2 E, publié en 1943, le détail des registres paroissiaux disparus.» No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Marne
providers.what: Châlons-en-Champagne. État civil, the 1836–1946 censuses, maps and plans from before 1800, the 1914–1918 war, the cadastre 1800–2000 and the military matricules, each with its own search.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /page/archives-numerisees lists «Etat civil · Recensements, 1836-1946 · Cartes et plans avant 1800 · Guerre 1914-1918 · Cadastre 1800-2000 · Matricules militaires». A separate page offers «Plus de 3000 images pour combler des lacunes» in the état civil and census collections.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Martinique
providers.what: Fort-de-France. The Archives territoriales publish a genealogical research guide for Martinique alongside the état civil search — useful, because the island's registers carry the particular history of the colony.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /search/form/8ea80f22-2f9c-456b-94a0-adbd50d31e1c is an open état civil search; /document/guide-de-recherche-genealogique-en-martinique and /page/archives-numerisees are both reachable.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Mayenne
providers.what: Laval. A single form searches the acts and the communal tables for the whole département.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /archives-en-ligne/etat-civil-search-form.html opens straight onto «Recherche dans l'état civil — Consultation des actes et tables des communes mayennaises», with 61 form controls and no sign-in.

providers.name: Archives départementales de Mayotte
providers.what: Mamoudzou, 1 impasse des Terrasses. The service exists and is reachable by post and e-mail (archives.mayotte@cg976.fr), but it has no working web page: the only URL published for it — by FranceArchives, the national portal, as well as here — returns a 404, and the département's own Culture et patrimoine menu lists the museum, the bibliothèque départementale and the monuments historiques, with no archive service among them. Nothing is known from here about what, if anything, is online.
providers.triageNote: Checked 2026-10-09. mayotte.fr/le-conseil-departemental/institution/services-administratifs/archives returns «404 — Page introuvable»; so does ?s=archives, which redirects to the homepage. FranceArchives service/34519 lists the same dead URL alongside the postal address, phone 02.69.66.16.09 and archives.mayotte@cg976.fr. No sitemap.xml. No positive evidence of online access, so access stays unsurveyed rather than guessed.

providers.name: Archives départementales de Meurthe-et-Moselle
providers.what: Nancy, with the images on archivesenligne.meurthe-et-moselle.fr. Parish and civil registers online; the archive publicly warns readers that AI-generated answers to research questions are not to be trusted.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. archivesenligne.meurthe-et-moselle.fr/archives-en-ligne/registres-paroissiaux-et-detat-civil loads its own «Registres paroissiaux et d'état civil» section with no sign-in.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Meuse
providers.what: Bar-le-Duc. The most consulted collections out of 25 linear kilometres of holdings have been digitised.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /page/archives-en-ligne reads «ont numérisé et mis en ligne les fonds les plus consultés parmi les 25 kilomètres linéaires de documents».

providers.name: Archives départementales du Morbihan
providers.what: Vannes, inside the département's combined patrimoine and archives site. Every parish and civil register from the 16th century to the early 20th is online, and a PDF states the consultation position collection by collection.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /rechercher/archives/archives-en-ligne reads «Ensemble des registres paroissiaux et d'état civil depuis le 16e siècle des communes du Morbihan jusqu'au début du 20e siècle». A 2024 news item announces état civil and census additions.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Moselle
providers.what: Metz. Moselle went with Alsace in 1871 and came back with it in 1918, which is why a Lorraine family's records can be in German for forty-seven years and French on either side.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Nièvre
providers.what: Nevers. État civil, population censuses, and the declarations of pregnancy 1758–1790 — a series few archives have digitised.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /page/archives-en-ligne reads «Retrouvez tous les documents numérisés avec ces formulaires de recherche» and lists «Généalogie · État civil · Recensements de population · Déclarations de grossesse 1758-1790».

providers.name: Archives de Paris
providers.what: The Archives de Paris, which hold the capital's état civil. Alongside the usual collections there is a dedicated «Mémoire des attentats de 2015» section and the profits illicites files.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /archives-numerisees opens with no sign-in; the same menu carries «Recherche dans les inventaires en ligne», «Recherche topographique» and «Communicabilité des archives».

providers.name: Archives départementales du Pas-de-Calais
providers.what: Dainville. Archives numérisées under «Chercher», with the enregistrement succession tables and the military matricule sheets among the recent additions.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /Chercher/Archives-numerisees loads with no sign-in. Cookie banner declined; two 2026 news items announce the matricules militaires and the «tables de successions et absences (5C, 3Q)».

providers.name: Archives départementales du Puy-de-Dôme
providers.what: Clermont-Ferrand. Inventories and digitised archives both consultable, with tutorials and research-help workshops for readers new to the sources.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /n/rechercher/n:149 reads «Consulter les inventaires · Consulter les archives numérisées». Another anti-bot host; it cleared on retry. An «Espace personnel» exists but is not asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Pyrénées-Atlantiques
providers.what: The archives départementales for Pyrénées-Atlantiques — in France, where a département's parish registers and civil registers are deposited. Harvested from Wikidata and not yet opened: what is online, and at what price, is unchecked.
providers.triageNote: Declined 2026-10-09, twice. archives.le64.fr answers with «Attack detected» — «Your request has been blocked. Date: 2026-10-09T02:49:32+0000. Request UID: ashWPEDhyoGsIOCKa4Qo1gAAAAw». curl gets HTTP 403. Row stays unsurveyed.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Pyrénées-Orientales
providers.what: Perpignan. Parish and civil registers, military matricules, censuses, mortgage registers, the Napoleonic cadastre, death and succession tables, and the iconography of the Retirada and the internment camps — ELEVEN categories, all free. But the Département has blocked archives.cd66.fr to everyone outside France, indefinitely, and says so on its own page. From abroad the images cannot be reached at all.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-10-09. ledepartement66.fr/lesarchivesenligne/ states: «Pour intensifier la sécurité, le Département des Pyrénées-Orientales a décidé de bloquer l'accès hors de France au site Internet : http://archives.cd66.fr. En conséquence, les internautes résidant à l'étranger ne pourront plus se connecter sur les “archives en ligne” des Archives départementales, pour une période indéterminée.» Navigation to archives.cd66.fr/mdr/index.php/rechercheTheme failed from here, consistent with that notice. The category list and the collection-history documents are readable on the département's own site; the viewer is not. Not a bot gate — a stated geographic block.

providers.name: Archives départementales de Saône-et-Loire
providers.what: Mâcon. «Des millions de données accessibles gratuitement et à toute heure», across nine thematic sections; «Familles et individus» carries the tables décennales, the cahiers paroissiaux and registres d'état civil, recensements, matricules and the Grande collecte 14-18.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — one of the twelve. 106 links on the home page; /consulter/en-ligne opens on «Des millions de données accessibles gratuitement et à toute heure». No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Sarthe
providers.what: Le Mans. Parish and civil registers before 1902 and civil registers after it, kept as separate collections, with the complete matricules of the Sarthe recruitment bureaux.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — one of the twelve. /archives-en-ligne: «Registres paroissiaux et d'état civil antérieurs à 1902», «Registres d'état civil postérieurs à 1902», «La totalité des registres matricules des bureaux de recrutement de la Sarthe». No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Savoie
providers.what: Chambéry, inside the département's patrimoines portal, with the catalogue on recherche-archives.savoie.fr. Simple and guided search are both open; signing in only reserved documents for the reading room, and that is being withdrawn in February 2026. The Chambéry mortgage transcriptions are being digitised in phases.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. recherche-archives.savoie.fr offers «Recherche simple · Recherche guidée» without signing in, and announces that «la réservation de documents en ligne ne sera plus accessible à partir du 1er février 2026».

providers.name: Archives départementales de Seine-et-Marne
providers.what: The archives départementales for Seine-et-Marne — in France, where a département's parish registers and civil registers are deposited. Harvested from Wikidata and not yet opened: what is online, and at what price, is unchecked.
providers.surveyQuote: 11 125 registres paroissiaux ou d'etat civil sont en ligne, de meme que 286 tables decennales et 107 registres de publication de mariage. Cela represente au total environ 4 017 266 pages d'etat civil accessibles par ce biais.
providers.surveyNote: Read 27 Sep 2026: the etat civil page names no account, no subscription and no charge, and states the CNIL delays that apply on the internet specifically - births 100 years, marriages 75, deaths 25. About 1,000 further registers are digitised but reading-room only, which is a gap in what is online rather than a charge for it.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Seine-Maritime
providers.what: Rouen. Thirteen digitised series, among them the Journal de Rouen, the inscription maritime, the registres d'écrou and the hospital administration, with a cross-collection search over the lot. The état civil runs all the way to the page image — browse by commune, typologie (registre / tables décennales) and type d'acte, with every view served over IIIF. Two 1843 death acts were read end to end on 2026-10-09 with no account, no fee and no reader's ticket. TWO TRAPS, BOTH VERIFIED. Registers of communes a town absorbed are filed UNDER THE TOWN, with the old commune in an «Ancienne commune» field — Ingouville, Sanvic, Bléville and Rouelles all sit under «Havre (Le)». So searching the absorbed commune's own name can return a DIFFERENT commune of the same name elsewhere in the department: Ingouville near Le Havre and Ingouville-sur-Mer near Saint-Valery-en-Caux are sixty kilometres apart and both are just «Ingouville» on the result card. The image URL disambiguates them (…/havre_le/ingouville/… against …/ingouville-sur-mer/…), and so does volume size.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /n/archives-numerisees/n:164 lists «Recherche transversale · Etat civil · Recensements de population · Journal de Rouen · Matricules militaires · Inscription maritime · Enregistrement · Hypothèques · Cadastre · Iconographie · Registres d'écrou · Administration hospitalière». Another anti-bot host. The anti-bot host is ANUBIS (a «techaro.lol-anubis-auth» cookie, proof-of-work): it clears by itself in a browser and needs nothing from the visitor. It is NOT to be worked around — direct image requests made outside the browser answer for a while and then return a 256×256 placeholder PNG instead of the tile, and the cookie must not be replayed to get past that. Read in the browser and it simply works.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Seine-Saint-Denis
providers.what: Bobigny. The département was carved out in 1968, so its état civil search is by commune — Saint-Denis, Montreuil, Aubervilliers, Pantin and the rest.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /archive/recherche/etatcivil/n:217 redirects straight to results with the commune list populated and 29 form controls; no sign-in. Another anti-bot host.

providers.name: Service du patrimoine archivistique et audiovisuel du Territoire de Polynésie française
providers.what: Te Piha Faufa'a Tupuna at Pape'ete. Its published récolement of the French Polynesian état civil 1852–1934 is the thing to read first: an island-by-island table that says, for each district and atoll, which years exist in Tahitian and which in French, which are digitised, and whether they are online or only on the shelf at Tipaeru'i. The colonial état civil itself is digitised at ANOM (caomec2), not here.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /etat-civil-test/ prints the récolement under two explicit headings — «ARCHIVES CONSULTABLES SUR PLACE AU DÉPÔT DES ARCHIVES DE TIPAERU'I À PAPE'ETE» and «ARCHIVES ACCESSIBLES EN LIGNE SUR INTERNET» — with columns for Tahitian, French, digital format and year ranges, and rows from Afaahiti and Afareaitu through Ahe, Akamaru, Amanu and Anaa. It links on to anom.archivesnationales.culture.gouv.fr/caomec2/.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Somme
providers.what: Amiens. État civil, population, military and war records, the fiscal and notarial archives (3E), the conseil général and communal deliberations, maps, and a collection on the mills of the Somme. The archive says plainly that some media stay in the reading room for rights or closure-period reasons.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /page/archives-en-ligne-1 lists «Etat civil · Population, individus · Militaires, Guerres · Archives fiscales · Archives notariales (3E) · Délibérations des Conseils généraux … · Délibérations communales · Images · Cartes et plans · Les moulins de la Somme», above the notice that «certains médias … sont uniquement visibles en salle de lecture pour des questions de droits ou de délais de communicabilité».

providers.name: Archives départementales du Tarn
providers.what: The archives départementales for Tarn — in France, where a département's parish registers and civil registers are deposited. Harvested from Wikidata and not yet opened: what is online, and at what price, is unchecked.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-05. «Documents numérisés» offers consultation en ligne with no account asked for anywhere on the page, so `free` rather than `account`. NOTE THE 418: a scripted check of this host is answered by an anti-DDoS flood-protection page, not by the archive — in a browser it resolves straight to the real site. That is the proof that the other refusals below are gates and not graves.

providers.name: Archives départementales du Territoire de Belfort
providers.what: Belfort. Fourteen digitised series, including a collection on the history of the Anabaptist Mennonites, the assisted children, the combatant cards for those born 1843–1909, and the trade marks 1859–1936.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /page/acceder-aux-fonds-numerises lists «Etat civil · Histoire des anabaptistes mennonites · Recensements · Enfants assistés · Registres matricules (1867-1940) · Cartes de combattants (nés entre 1843 et 1909) · Plans militaires (1828-1898) · Recherche foncière · Enregistrement (1791-1945) · Presse (1870-1942) · Fonds iconographiques · Immatriculations (1899-1928) · Marques de fabrique (1859-1936)».

providers.name: Archives départementales du Val-d'Oise
providers.what: Cergy-Pontoise. Seven series digitised in full — état civil, censuses, iconography, postcards, built heritage, maps and plans, press — and a published list of the finding aids whose collections are only partly digitised.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /n/archives-numerisees/n:418 lists those seven and adds «D'autres fonds ont fait l'objet de numérisations partielles : découvrez la liste des instruments de recherche concernés». Another anti-bot host; it cleared on retry.

providers.name: Archives départementales du Val-de-Marne
providers.what: Créteil, and it states the communicability tiers more exactly than any other archive in this survey. The greffe collection runs to 1952; beyond that, the mairies. Online: all acts 1549–1922; some marriages and deaths to 1937 depending on the commune. In the reading room only: births and marriages 1923–1943, and deaths to 1952. It also runs collaborative annotation and bookmarks.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — one of the twelve. 147 links on the home page. /recherches/archives-en-ligne/etat-civil: «Entre 1549 et 1922 : vous pouvez consulter les actes de naissance, mariage et décès en ligne. Après 1922 : certains actes de mariage et de décès sont consultables en ligne jusqu'en 1937 en fonction des communes.» No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales du Var
providers.what: Draguignan. Digitised archives and inventories searched together, with a stated policy on reuse and a form for reporting an anomaly in the digitised holdings — which is the quiet sign of an archive that expects its scans to be wrong sometimes and wants to hear about it.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — one of the twelve. 107 links on the home page; /recherche/rechercher-dans-les-archives-numerisees-et-les-inventaires is open with no account, and the site carries «Réutiliser les archives» and «Signaler une anomalie dans les fonds numérisés».

providers.name: Archives départementales de Vaucluse
providers.what: Avignon, inside Memento, the département's combined archives, museums and archaeology portal. Free-text search, the état des fonds, and the classification series are three separate ways in to the same digitised images.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. /dans-les-archives/consultation-en-ligne-archives reads «Interrogez les fonds grâce à la recherche libre avec un mot clé, naviguez dans l'état des fonds ou dans les grandes séries du cadre de classement», and offers a «panorama des fonds».

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Vendée
providers.what: La Roche-sur-Yon. Over SIX MILLION images against 150,000 descriptions, with état civil from its sixteenth-century origin to the legal limit — and the «Noms de Vendée» base of 3.5 MILLION NOMINATIVE RECORDS over the top of it, the largest volunteer name index met in this survey. Beauchet-Filleau's genealogical dictionary of Poitou families sits beside it.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER. One of the twelve, and the ONE WHOSE NOTE WAS TECHNICALLY RIGHT: this site really does render client-side, and a fetch of its pages returns nothing. That was still never a reason to leave it unsurveyed — it is free and enormous. «Plus de 6 millions d'images sont ainsi consultables en ligne» and «la base "Noms de Vendée" (3,5 millions de relevés nominatifs)». No account asked for.

providers.name: Archives départementales de la Vienne
providers.what: Poitiers, sharing one portal with the Deux-Sèvres: the two départements run a joint site, so a search crosses both.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 in a browser; open with no account asked for. The portal titles itself «Portail commun Archives départementales des Deux-Sèvres et de la Vienne»; /archive/recherche/ecalternatif/n:100 is an open état civil search beside «Inventaires en ligne» and «Archives en ligne». Another anti-bot host.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Vosges
providers.what: The archives départementales for Vosges — in France, where a département's parish registers and civil registers are deposited. Harvested from Wikidata and not yet opened: what is online, and at what price, is unchecked.
providers.triageNote: Unreachable 2026-10-09. archives.vosges.fr resolves to 92.103.52.35 but every connection times out, on port 443 and on port 80 alike — not a refusal, no bytes at all. www.vosges.fr (92.103.52.33) times out the same way, so the whole département's network is dark from here rather than the archive alone. No alternative hostname resolves. Row stays unsurveyed.

providers.name: Archives départementales des Yvelines
providers.what: Montigny-le-Bretonneux — AND IT HOLDS PART OF THE OLD SEINE-ET-OISE, the département abolished in 1968 and split into six. So a commune now in the Essonne, the Val-d'Oise or the Hauts-de-Seine may have its pre-1968 registers here, which is the sort of thing that makes a search fail for a reason nobody would guess. 1.6 million views: parish registers 1533–1792, births 1792–1920, marriages 1792–1943, deaths into the 1950s for some communes.
providers.triageNote: Surveyed 2026-10-09 IN A BROWSER — the last of the twelve. 146 links on the home page. «La quasi-totalité des actes des registres paroissiaux et d'état civil de toutes les paroisses et communes des Yvelines et d'une partie de l'ancienne Seine-et-Oise, du XVIe siècle jusqu'à la moitié du XXe siècle sont numérisés, soit 1,6 millions de vues.» No account asked for; cookie banner left unanswered.

providers.name: Archiwum Główne Akt Dawnych (AGAD)
providers.what: Warsaw's archive of the old Republic — the metrical books of the Polish partitions, including eastern Galician parishes now in Ukraine. Catalogued here; the scans are published through Szukaj w Archiwach.

providers.name: Archivo General de la Nación (Argentina)
providers.what: Argentina's national archive — immigration and naturalisation above all. Civil registration itself is PROVINCIAL and is not here; the provinces keep their own.

providers.name: Archivo General de la Nación (México)
providers.what: Mexico's national archive. Parish registers and civil registration sit with the dioceses and the states, so this is the top of the system rather than where a baptism is. Harvested and its address opened, nothing more: what it holds, what is online and what it costs to look are unchecked here.

providers.name: Ancestry
providers.what: The largest commercial collection. Strong on the English-speaking world, censuses and immigration; weak on continental parish registers.

providers.name: ANNO — Austrian Newspapers Online
providers.what: The Austrian National Library's digitised newspaper run. Full-text searchable, and it covers the whole empire — which is why it finds Croatian and Istrian names.

providers.name: Antenati
providers.what: The Italian state archives' own portal. Civil registration images from 1806, free and without an account — the best national genealogy portal in Europe.

providers.name: Arquivo Público do Estado do Espírito Santo
providers.what: Espírito Santo's state archive, a small state with a large Italian and Pomeranian settlement history. Harvested and its address opened, nothing more: what it holds, what is online and what it costs to look are unchecked here.

providers.name: Arquivo Público do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul
providers.what: Rio Grande do Sul's state archive — German and Italian colony records, and the civil registration of the far south. Harvested and its address opened, nothing more: what it holds, what is online and what it costs to look are unchecked here.

providers.name: Arquivo Público do Estado de São Paulo
providers.what: São Paulo's state archive — the state that took the largest share of Italian, Portuguese, Spanish and Japanese emigration to Brazil, and holds the immigration records that go with it. Harvested and its address opened, nothing more: what it holds, what is online and what it costs to look are unchecked here.

providers.name: Arquivo Público Mineiro
providers.what: Minas Gerais' state archive, with its own online catalogue. Harvested and its address opened, nothing more: what it holds, what is online and what it costs to look are unchecked here.

providers.name: Arcanum Digitheca (ADT)
providers.what: Hungary's digitised press, gazettes and reference works, full-text searchable. Worked by the Blažević archive for the Smojvers of Karlobag in the Hungarian state record, and again searching place names rather than surnames. Not yet surveyed for what an ordinary visitor can reach.
providers.triageNote: Added from the family research archives, which record work actually done here. Access class still needs a person.

providers.name: Rijksarchief / Archives de l'État
providers.what: The State Archives of Belgium, which hold the parish registers and the civil status registers for the whole country — the thing a Belgian search actually needs, and which this atlas was pointing at Geneanet for. WHAT WAS VERIFIED AND WHAT WAS NOT, on 23 Sep 2026: arch.be itself opens. Its genealogical search has moved to agatha.arch.be, which arch.be links to and which would not answer us at all — it completes a TLS handshake and then closes the connection, to a script and to a browser alike. The old host, search.arch.be, is retired and answers 200 for every path with an end-of-life notice, including the three URLs the State Archives' own «Search engines» page still links to. `account` is the class because consulting the scans requires a free registration; that is documented rather than tested here, and this note is the honest record of which.

providers.name: Archieven.nl
providers.what: One search across more than ninety Dutch archives — 133 million person records, 59,308 inventories, and the finding aids themselves rather than only the indexed names. It is the layer above WieWasWie: WieWasWie tells you a birth was registered, this tells you which shelf the register sits on and what else that archive holds about the family. Free to search; whether the scan behind a hit opens depends on the institution that holds it, and this atlas has not walked all ninety.

providers.name: Archion
providers.what: The German Protestant church archives' own portal. Subscription by the month; the only route to many Lutheran registers.

providers.name: Internet Archive
providers.what: Full-text search across millions of digitised books, including parish histories, nobiliaries and local monographs that name ordinary people.

providers.name: Archives New Zealand — Collections
providers.what: New Zealand probate, military and immigration records, much of it digitised and free.

providers.name: Archiwum Państwowe w Bydgoszczy
providers.what: The Polish state archive for the Kuyavian-Pomeranian voivodeship, holding the civil registers of the former Prussian registry offices of the region, Szubin among them. IT ANSWERS LETTERS AND WILL SHARE SCANS: three e-mails in September 2026 were each answered within about eight days, in Polish, over the Director's signature with a named case officer. It points first at genealogiawarchiwach.pl for what is already digitised, and then supplied a 103-scan volume that is NOT on that portal, shared from its own OneDrive. TWO HOLDINGS FACTS IT STATED BY LETTER THAT NO ONLINE CATALOGUE SHOWS: the metrical books of the Jewish religious community of Szubin survive ONLY for 1820-1847; and the alphabetical death indexes (skorowidze zgonów) of USC Szubin Miasto survive ONLY for 1874-1878 and 1894-1924, with nothing between. An archivist there will also read a difficult line from a register on request and say plainly where the reading is uncertain.
providers.triageNote: Added from the Luwinski Family archive after three letters were answered in September 2026. Access class still needs a person: nothing was paid, no fee schedule was seen, and the reading room was not visited.

providers.name: Lietuvos archyvai (Lithuanian State Archives)
providers.what: The Lithuanian state archives, including the Memel/Klaipėda district — German ground until 1945 whose records did not all leave with the population.

providers.name: ARHiNET — Croatian State Archives
providers.what: The Croatian State Archives, and through it the national register of archival fonds — which archive holds which fonds; the paper itself is almost all unphotographed. THE OLD LINK HERE WAS DEAD. This row pointed at arhinet.arhiv.hr, which no longer resolves at all — NXDOMAIN on Google's and Cloudflare's resolvers both, not a timeout or a redirect, so every Croatian researcher who clicked ARHiNET on this map got nothing. hais.arhiv.hr resolves to 161.53.80.20 and serves NOTHING ON EITHER PORT 80 OR 443 — tested 30 September 2026 with curl, which is the difference between a service that is down and one that is refusing us: the host answers DNS and nothing is listening. NOTE ALSO that hais was described here as ARHiNET's "successor"; that is not established by anyone who has checked, and a family archive that repeated it had to withdraw the claim. www.arhiv.hr is a DIFFERENT machine, 161.53.80.7, it works, and it is NOT the fonds register — neither the word ARHiNET nor HAIS appears anywhere on it in either language. What it does carry is the live register search, provider hda-mk-search. So this row points at a working site that answers a different question; the national fonds register currently has no working address known to this atlas. NOTE: the same site DOES carry a working register search — see provider hda-mk-search — which indexes the microfilmed register collection HR-HDA-1448 and answers whether a given parish was filmed. That is a separate tool from the fonds register described above, and it is the one to reach for first when the question is about matične knjige.

providers.name: Arhiv Vojvodine
providers.what: Novi Sad. Vojvodina was Hungarian ground until 1918, so its registers are in the Hungarian series and its finding aids are in three languages — this archive is where the two filing systems meet.

providers.name: Agenția Națională a Arhivelor (Moldova)
providers.what: Moldova's National Archives Agency. OPENED 2026-09-29: it publishes ONLINE INVENTORIES — its own front page announces inventories for the Soviet period 1917–1940 — and a separate notice about restoring access to its digital collections, so images may exist beyond the finding aids; that part is not confirmed and the access class here describes the inventories, which are. Until today Moldova's only source was ROMANIA's national archive, correct for interwar Bessarabia and silent on Transnistria and the Soviet-era record.
providers.triageNote: Named from Wikidata; homepage read directly on 2026-09-29 except where the row says otherwise.

providers.name: Arhiv Bosne i Hercegovine
providers.what: The state archive in Sarajevo. Ottoman-era defters, the Austro-Hungarian administration's own paper from 1878, and almost nothing online — this is a letter or a visit.

providers.name: Arhivele Naționale ale României
providers.what: The Romanian national archives, county by county. Holds the Bukovinan and Transylvanian registers for the years those provinces were Romanian, which is not the same span as the years they existed.

providers.name: Arhiv Srbije
providers.what: The Serbian state archive. Church registers for the pre-1918 Kingdom, and the administrative record of a state that was Ottoman ground until 1878.

providers.name: Arolsen Archives
providers.what: The former International Tracing Service. Concentration camp, forced labour and displaced-persons records for some seventeen and a half million people, free and fully indexed.

providers.name: Arolsen Archives
providers.what: The Arolsen Archives — the international centre on Nazi persecution, and the most openly searchable large collection in Germany. You search DOCUMENTS BY PERSON: surname, forename, birth name, date of birth, prisoner number. No account, no fee. For anyone whose family was deported, imprisoned, conscripted as forced labour or displaced, this is the first place to look and not the last.

providers.name: Arquivo Nacional (Brasil)
providers.what: Brazil's national archive. Civil registration in Brazil is held by cartórios and the states rather than here, so this is the top of the system rather than where a birth record sits. Harvested and its address opened, nothing more: what it holds, what is online and what it costs to look are unchecked here.
